eira.acquisition: Available at the start; also in Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Automatically use damage skills when ready.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Deal damage to multiple targets and heal yourself. Requires 100 Energy.

mira.acquisition: Clear campaign stage 2 or obtain from Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Attack magic; switches to healing when an ally falls below 85% HP.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Heal and shield surviving allies. Requires 100 Energy.

skill_descriptions.basic: Automatically use damage skills when ready.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Deal damage to multiple targets and heal yourself; also gain a shield. Requires 100 Energy.

lyra.acquisition: Clear campaign stage 3 or obtain from Standard Summon.

skill_descriptions.basic: Automatically use damage skills when ready.
skill_descriptions.ultimate: Deal damage to multiple targets and heal yourself. Requires 100 Energy.
